recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, low-key photograph of a man in a suit leaning against a large pillar in a dark architectural arcade, with a distant figure and glowing lanterns creating a sense of depth and mystery.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in the foreground left balanced by a smaller figure in the deep background right
Repetitive verticality of massive columns and railings against horizontal shadows
Warm lantern light contrasting with cool blue-tinted shadows and smoke
Tight white border framing a dark, high-contrast interior scene
coreInvariants: Visible film grain and soft focus

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is medium-full shot on the left third; secondary subject is small-scale in the far right background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit face and shirt of the primary subject against the dark pillar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the primary subject, follows the horizontal light beam/smoke across to the distant figure, then up to the lanterns and top-aligned text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of deep black negative space in the lower half and between architectural elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and ochre (lanterns and skin tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted crimson (text and tie) and hazy blue (smoke)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between light sources and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy tones and deep blacks

characterSpecificRedesigns: Uniformly tall x-height matching cap height

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the top white margin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with color shifts to distinguish name from title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and high contrast serifs.
Provides the necessary Didone elegance in a condensed form.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Photograph a man in a dark suit leaning against a large stone pillar in a dimly lit classical arcade at night. Use a single warm light source from a wall lantern and a hazy blue fill light. Include a small figure in the distant background. Frame the image with a thick white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place extra-condensed serif text in all-caps across the top white margin. Use a dark red for the first two words and black for the final word, ensuring the text spans the width of the image area.

verificationChecks: Is the text perfectly aligned within the top white border?
Does the lighting create a strong chiaroscuro effect?
Is the film grain visible but not distracting?
Are the serifs on the typography sharp and thin?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the red text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of the white frame
Ensure the color temperature contrast (warm vs cool) is maintained
Confirm the subject is positioned on the left third
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic Low-Key Portrait + Architectural Arcade + Condensed Didone Typography + White Border Frame
